title: Automated golden-sequence oracle and SLO gate for adaptive FP8/INT8 rollouts
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Build an automated validation harness that acts as a golden-sequence oracle + SLO gate for FP8/INT8 quantized rollouts. The harness will run weighted golden sequences (prompt cohorts) against floating-point baseline and quantized candidates, compute suite-level and cohort-level metrics (exact-match, n-gram fidelity, embedding-similarity, calibrated logit deltas), and enforce pass/fail gates tied to configured SLOs before allowing canary expansion.
goals: Create a reusable golden-sequence oracle capable of deterministic replay of golden prompts across sequence lengths and sampling modes
Define and compute multi-dimensional fidelity metrics including per-token KL, top-k concordance, embedding cosine, and answer-level correctness
Implement an automated pass/fail gating policy that integrates with rollout controller (canary -> expand -> rollback)
Provide dashboards and alerting for cohort drift, metric regressions, and gating decisions
Enable configuration of cohort weights, slack thresholds, and escalation rules per-customer or per-model
success_criteria: End-to-end pipeline validates a quantized candidate with <= configured delta for primary SLOs across all golden cohorts
Canary deployments are automatically blocked or rolled back when gate fails in CI or production canary stage
Dashboards surface cohort-level regressions within 5 minutes of a job completion
Tooling is reusable for FP8 and INT8 profiles and accepts quant config artifacts (quant.json) as input
acceptance_tests: Smoke: run harness against small golden set and assert metrics computed and stored in telemetry DB
Regression: introduce synthetic perturbation that degrades top-k concordance by 2% and assert gate fails
Scale: run a full-profile job (50k sequences across 12 cohorts) within defined resource and time budget
Integrations: successful webhook/HTTP callback to rollout controller with pass/fail payloads
Repro: given same seed and inputs, oracle replay produces identical tokenization and scoring across runs
design_notes: Golden sequences are organized into cohorts (short-chitchat, docs-QA, multi-turn agent, code-gen, structured-output) with normalized weights
Use deterministic sampling (seeded nucleus/top-k) when needed to reduce variance during scoring
Baseline is FP16/FP32 model; for candidates we accept both FP8/INT8 variants and mixed-precision fallbacks
Metrics: combine local micro-metrics (per-token KL, logit-gap) with macro metrics (exact-match, F1 for QA, embedding-similarity) into a composite fidelity score
Gate logic: configurable: e.g., block if composite_score drops >1.5% or any cohort drops >2% with high-weight cohorts considered first
Telemetry: push raw outputs and metric aggregates to observability pipeline; keep anonymized raw tokens only for internal audit with retention policy
implementation_plan: 1) Define golden cohorts and curate initial 3k sequences (PM + Research).
2) Build deterministic replay harness: tokenize -> feed -> capture logits/kv-states -> store outputs (ENG team).
3) Implement metric library in Rust + Python edge bindings for fast per-token KL and cosine computations.
4) Create gating service that consumes metric aggregates and evaluates JSON policy; expose REST webhook for rollout controller.
5) Integrate with CI: nightly calibration jobs and pre-rollout canary checks; create a manual override flow for on-call.
6) Bake dashboard and alert runbooks (SRE + Product) and create runbook steps for blocked rollouts.
7) Run pilot with 1 internal model and 2 customer-like workloads; iterate thresholds and cohort weights.
8) Ship rollout: integrate gate with canary controller and enable automatic rollback on failure.
rollout_plan: Pilot: internal-only for 2 weeks; collect false-positive/negative tallies
Limited customers: enable for Dedicated customers with experimental flag for 1 month
General availability: enable for all rollouts once pilot thresholds are hardened and SRE runbooks validated
Post-GA: add policy templates for enterprise customers and per-tenant tuning
telemetry_and_dashboards: Dashboard: 'Quant Fidelity — Golden Cohorts' with composite score, cohort breakdown, streaks, and run history
Alerts: critical if composite_score delta > configured threshold or canary gate fails at expansion step
Stored artifacts: metric aggregates in timeseries DB; trimmed outputs + embeddings in object storage for 30 days
Diagnostic view: tie gate decision to example counterexamples and show token-level KL deltas for inspection
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: High variance in sampling causes flaky gates -> Mitigation: deterministic replay and repeat-run averaging
Risk: Golden set not representative -> Mitigation: continuous golden curation + periodic seeded sampling from production traces
Risk: Storage and PII concerns for saved outputs -> Mitigation: strict anonymization, retention policy, and customer opt-out
Risk: Gate too sensitive blocking legitimate rollouts -> Mitigation: configurable slack, canary staging, manual override with audit logs
dependencies_notes: Requires quant profile artifact format from Quant Team (ENG-641999)
Needs console metrics ingestion pipeline changes (ENG-841450)
Coordination with SRE for rollout controller webhooks and auto-rollback paths
PM to finalize cohort weighting and primary SLO definitions
